title: Lasted Only 3.5 months - Avoid!
text: At first, the connection to my iPod was fairly tight.  After about a month, it began to get loose.  After two months, it would slide off very easily as the connection was no longer tight at all.  After only 3.5 months, it quit working all together.  I'd give this zero stars if I could.  After this one failed, I ordered three pairs off of Ebay.  Those worked for even less time (maybe a week or two each).  I believe all of the non-Apple cords, whether from Amazon or Ebay, are cheap knock-offs.  I've also heard about fires that resulted from some, so yet another reason to avoid.  I wasted around $20 between this one from Amazon and the ones from Ebay.  I could have bought a new, proper cord from Apple for that price, so that's what I finally ended up doing, and it works perfectly (just like the original one did for many years).  {Apple claims that none of the knock-offs have correctly copied their proprietary connector design which truly works}.  Bottom line - my opinion is that it's better to save your money and not buy these cheap knock-offs, but rather bite the bullet and buy the $20 cord from Apple.  You'll end up saving $'s, time, and aggravation  in the long run.

None of the replacements had this feature and it is what leads to the housing eventually pulling away from the cable. This one does not have the release buttons either.
